text: The system is permanently read-only with respect to financial execution, custody, signing, and transaction construction.
Agent intelligence never replaces deterministic identity, evidence, time, execution, risk, capability, rights, cost, quota, capacity, or policy controls.
No automated external side effect occurs directly from model output.
Every retained decision is reconstructable from frozen evidence, availability, acquisition state, configuration, code, adapter, and artifact versions.
Historical replay uses only data and learned artifacts actually available to the system at the simulated time.
Backfilled historical data is never backdated into production replay.
Evaluation includes alerts, watches, ignores, rejects, below-cutoff cases, exploration/control cases, and missed opportunities under symmetric action-time semantics.
Provider count is not source independence; declared lineage and empirical dependence both constrain effective confirmation.
A durable workflow or collector may retry; every state transition and external side effect remains idempotent and fenced.
The primary policy objective is conservative net shadow-portfolio utility under finite capital and hard constraints, not isolated price appreciation or alert win rate.
Signal success is not tradable success.
Unmatured, censored, or invalid outcomes never enter final success/failure denominators without explicit, separate reporting.
Economic events, not raw route legs or provider transaction counts, drive actor, volume, and demand features.
Deterministic chain/token/pool security can veto external provider optimism.
Program/version-specific execution math or verified quote parity is required; unsupported pool structures cause abstention.
Base and conservative execution stress cases are mandatory for confirmed opportunity decisions.
Broad discovery combines aggregate breadth with bounded first-party observation for the claimed supported-program universe.
Discovery and profitability claims never exceed the independently observed or validly sampled population.
Paid, unknown-cost, overage, automatic-upgrade, and paid-fallback data calls are impossible in data-provider `STRICT_FREE`.
Data-provider, model, infrastructure, storage/egress, and notification budgets are independent and explicit.
Every active configuration passes a sustainable-capacity contract with protected reserves.
Evidence not requested by policy is distinct from unavailable or negative evidence.
Exploration, high-resolution outcome observation, and randomized evidence acquisition remain statistically auditable.
A thesis is falsifiable, versioned, expiring, and separate from candidate identity.
“Why now” is derived from stored deltas and decision-time evidence, never invented retrospectively.
A compiled natural-language policy remains a draft until validated, evaluated, approved, and separately activated.
Narrative, cross-chain, crowding, analog, wallet, pattern, hazard, and regime outputs never override critical asset-level security or execution evidence.
Capability coverage is authoritative; the system never claims data, safety, execution, source independence, or alpha it cannot currently support.
Model unavailability degrades to deterministic operation rather than fabrication or silent failure.
Historical alpha is learned only from fully matured point-in-time execution-aware outcomes and appropriate matched/control populations.
No wallet, deployer, funder, pattern, narrative, provider, or multi-view confirmation is assumed independent without lineage analysis.
Novelty removes unsupported confidence but never automatically equals quality or rejection.
Critical disagreement is preserved and cannot be averaged away.
Portfolio value is evaluated with finite capital, concurrency, exposure, shared-liquidity competition, conservative path ordering, and opportunity cost.
Alpha artifacts may auto-degrade or pause on safety/drift evidence but never auto-activate or auto-reactivate.
Adversarial and synthetic fixtures remain isolated from real training, reputation, calibration, and outcome populations.
MCP Streamable HTTP validates Origin, protocol, authentication, resource scope, and request shape before execution.
Provider bundles containing trading/private-key capability are never exposed wholesale; only allowlisted read-only adapters exist.
Critical decision/evidence/audit metadata uses tiered recovery objectives and tamper-evident audit checkpoints.
Public/workspace activation requires technical, OAuth, rights, privacy, jurisdiction, disclosure, claims, abuse-response, and support gates.
Requirement, acceptance, dependency, test, API/tool, persistence, and activation traceability is machine-checkable and release-blocking.
Deployed code is not equivalent to available data, proven alpha, active policy, or public authorization.

A confirmed opportunity must be current, within its profile window, independently evidenced, security-valid within coverage, manipulation-aware, executable under the active conservative scenario, not expired, capacity/cost-valid, semantically validated, statistically authorized, and idempotently deliverable.
No result is a guaranteed-profit claim or transaction recommendation.
